name: design_review
retrieval: keyword evidence describing the current proposal from the pinned meeting and approved files
citation: Exact supporting quotations retain source ID/version/hash/time or original file lines. Model synthesis is separately labelled inference with IDs of validated quotations; structural validation is not semantic proof.
abstention: If the proposal is not described in the evidence, say so; do not review an imagined design
style: State each assumption, failure scenario and validation step in one or two plain sentences.
Rank: put the item most worth checking first. Do not pad the list.
inference_label: Model suggestions (not meeting facts; check against the quotations)

termination.on_limit: further tool calls are denied; answer from evidence already retrieved or abstain

task_steps: Quote what the current proposal actually is; those quotations are the only meeting facts.
List the key assumptions the proposal depends on, and concrete scenarios in which it fails.
Name the one or two things most worth validating first, and why. Do not claim the team decided any of this.
